## 1. Content summary
1490-byte XML MPD, `type="dynamic"`, isoff-live profile, availabilityStartTime/
publishTime verbatim stamps, minimumUpdatePeriod PT2S, timeShiftBufferDepth PT30S,
one Period → one AdaptationSet → one Representation (1.2 Mbps 854x480 avc1)
with a representation-level SegmentTemplate (timescale 90000,
presentationTimeOffset 4500000) and a 3-entry SegmentTimeline: `S t=4500000
d=1800000 r=4`, `S d=900000` (t defaults), `S d=1800000 r=-1` (open-ended
negative repeat). Covers exactly the surface the ffmpeg muxer never emits.

## 2. Consumer test
`mpd::tests::hand_dynamic_fixture_types` (crates/playlists/src/mpd.rs:2364-2408)
pins: MpdType::Dynamic, minimumUpdatePeriod 2.0, timeShiftBufferDepth 30.0,
verbatim availabilityStartTime "2026-10-31T12:00:00Z", PTO 4_500_000, duration
None, timeline entries (t,d,r) = (4.5M,1.8M,4), (None,0.9M,None), (—,1.8M,-1).
All values match the fixture bytes (cross-checked by hand). Ran with the mpd
suite: 16/16 pass (my run). Test would fail if any pinned field regressed.
